en: Colorized early-20th‑century view from the top of a stone balustrade stairway looking into a formal landscaped park. There are manicured lawns, flower beds edged with red blooms, cone-shaped shrubs, statues and urns along the railings, and a central fountain in the distance. Several people in Edwardian-style clothing stroll along the wide gravel paths. A multi‑storey building with a red roof is visible beyond the trees at the far end of the park. A handwritten red number "18144" appears in the upper left corner.
